<｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter name="content" string="true">"""
Image tools for codx-junior.

Provides:
    * ``explain_image``  – analyse an image with a vision-capable model.
    * ``generate_image`` – generate an image from a text prompt.

Image generation uses the OpenAI images API via the ``openai`` python client
(``client.images.generate``). The model used for generation is resolved from
the global settings through :func:`codx.junior.global_settings.get_model_for_task`
so operators can pick any image-capable model (``model_type="image"``) without
touching this module.

The generated image is stored in the project under ``.codx/images`` and the
relative URL path is returned to the caller/model.

Made with ❤️ by codx-junior
"""

import base64
import logging
import os
from datetime import datetime
from io import BytesIO
from typing import Optional

from openai import OpenAI
from PIL import Image

from codx.junior.global_settings import (
    get_model_for_task,
    get_model_settings,
    read_global_settings,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Folder (relative to the project root) where generated images are stored.
GENERATED_IMAGE_FOLDER = ".codx/images"

# Task tag used to resolve the image-generation model from global settings.
IMAGE_GENERATION_TASK = "image-generation"


def _get_openai_client() -> OpenAI:
    """
    Build an OpenAI client for image generation.

    The base URL and API key come from the resolved image-generation model
    settings so any OpenAI-compatible provider can be used.

    Returns:
        Configured :class:`OpenAI` client.

    Raises:
        ValueError: When no image-generation model is configured.
    """
    try:
        model_settings = get_model_settings(
            get_model_for_task(IMAGE_GENERATION_TASK)
        )
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("No image-generation model configured: %s", ex)
        raise ValueError(
            "No image-generation model is configured. Select an image-capable "
            "model (model_type='image') in the global settings."
        ) from ex

    return OpenAI(
        api_key=model_settings.api_key,
        base_url=model_settings.api_url,
    ), model_settings


def _resolve_output_path(file_path: str) -> str:
    """
    Resolve the absolute output path, ensuring the parent folder exists.

    Args:
        file_path: Absolute or relative file path to store the image.

    Returns:
        The absolute path where the image will be written.
    """
    if not os.path.isabs(file_path):
        file_path = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), file_path)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(file_path), exist_ok=True)
    return file_path


def generate_image(  # type: ignore[override]
    prompt: str,
    size: str = "1024x1024",
    quality: str = "standard",
    file_path: Optional[str] = None,
) -> str:
    """
    Generate an image from a text prompt using the OpenAI images API.

    The model is resolved from the global settings (see
    :data:`IMAGE_GENERATION_TASK`) so operators can choose any image-capable
    model. The base64 payload returned by the API is decoded with the standard
    library and written to disk using Pillow.

    Args:
        prompt:    Text description of the image to generate.
        size:      Image dimensions (e.g. ``1024x1024``).
        quality:   Image quality (``standard`` | ``hd``).
        file_path: Optional output path. Defaults to
                   ``<project>/.codx/images/<timestamp>.png``.

    Returns:
        Relative URL path to the generated image (e.g.
        ``/.codx/images/generated_20231001_120000.png``).

    Raises:
        ValueError: When the prompt is empty or no image model is configured.

    Made with ❤️ by codx-junior
    """
    if not prompt or not prompt.strip():
        raise ValueError("Prompt is required to generate an image.")

    client, model_settings = _get_openai_client()

    if not file_path:
        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        file_path = os.path.join(
            GENERATED_IMAGE_FOLDER, f"generated_{timestamp}.png"
        )
    output_path = _resolve_output_path(file_path)

    logger.info(
        "generate_image: model=%s size=%s quality=%s -> %s",
        model_settings.model,
        size,
        quality,
        output_path,
    )

    response = client.images.generate(
        model=model_settings.model,
        prompt=prompt,
        size=size,
        quality=quality,
    )

    # Prefer the base64 payload; fall back to downloading the URL when the
    # provider only returns a URL.
    image_data = response.data[0]
    b64_json = getattr(image_data, "b64_json", None)
    image_url = getattr(image_data, "url", None)

    if b64_json:
        image_bytes = base64.b64decode(b64_json)
        image = Image.open(BytesIO(image_bytes))
        image.save(output_path)
    elif image_url:
        import urllib.request

        with urllib.request.urlopen(image_url) as resp:  # noqa: S310
            image_bytes = resp.read()
        with open(output_path, "wb") as fh:
            fh.write(image_bytes)
    else:
        raise ValueError("Image generation returned neither b64_json nor url.")

    relative_path = f"/{os.path.relpath(output_path, os.getcwd())}"
    relative_path = relative_path.replace(os.sep, "/")
    logger.info("generate_image: stored image at %s", relative_path)
    return relative_path
